title: Bioorthogonal click chemistry-based labelling of proteins in living neuronal cell lines and primary neurons
protocol: Pre-coat eight-well Lab-Tek II chambered coverglasses with 10 µg/ml poly-D-lysine in ddH₂O for a minimum of 4 h at RT.
Wash the pre-coated chambered coverglasses three times with ddH₂O and allow to dry under a sterile hood.
Collect ND7/23 cells from culturing plate.

Seed cells at density of 25,000 cells per well in 250 µl of culture medium containing high-glucose DMEM supplemented with 10% heat-inactivated fetal bovine serum, 1% penicillin-streptomycin (PS), 1% sodium pyruvate and 1% L-glutamine.
Culture seeded cells overnight at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Pre-warm Opti-MEM™ I Reduced Serum Medium to 37°C.
Prepare transfection mix with a DNA/Lipofectamine 2000 ratio of 1 µg:2.4 µl.
Add 12.5 µl of Opti-MEM to tube 1.
Add 0.25 µg of NFL<sup>K363TAG</sup>-FLAG, 0.25 µg of NES PylRS/tRNA<sub>CUA</sub><sup>Pyl</sup>, and 0.125 µg of NFM plasmid DNA to tube 1.
Add 12.5 µl of Opti-MEM to tube 2.
Add 1.5 µl of Lipofectamine 2000 transfection reagent to tube 2.
Vortex tubes gently for 10 seconds, then centrifuge briefly to spin down.
Incubate tubes 5 minutes at room temperature (RT).
Combine the contents of tube 1 with those of tube 2.
Vortex mixed solution gently for 10 seconds, then centrifuge briefly to spin down.
Incubate mixed solution 20 min at RT.
During the 20 min incubation period, prepare a 1:4 dilution of TCO*A-Lys in 1 M HEPES by mixing 1.875 µl of 1 M HEPES and 0.625 µl of 100 mM TCO*A-Lys stock solution.
Take the cells out of the incubator.
Add 25 µl of the transfection mix dropwise to the culturing medium.
Handle up to two Lab-Tek II chambered coverglasses at a time to prevent cooling of the culturing medium.
Add 2.5 µl of TCO*A-Lys dilution in a corner of the well.
Resuspend TCO*A-Lys by moving the Lab-Tek II chambered coverglass up and down, left and right.
Incubate the cells for 6 hours at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Prepare a fresh dilution of TCO*A-Lys as described in section I, step 9.
Pre-warm ND7/23 cell culturing medium to 37°C.
Aspirate the transfection mix-containing medium from cells.
Add 250 μl of warm ND7/23 cell culturing medium to each well.
Incubate the cells overnight at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Pre-warm the ND7/23 cell culturing medium to 37°C.
Remove TCO*A-Lys from cells by aspirating the medium and rinsing twice with warm cell culturing medium.
Add 250 μl of culturing medium per well in an eight-well Lab-Tek II chamber.
Incubate for 2-3 hours at 37°C with 5% CO2.
Prepare a 5 µM tetrazine-dye dilution in warm culturing medium.
Aspirate the medium from cells.
Rinse once more with warm culturing medium.
Add the tetrazine-dye dilution to cells.
Incubate for 10 min at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Aspirate the tetrazine-dye dilution from cells.
Rinse 2x with warm culturing medium.
Add 250 µl of culturing medium per one well of an eight-well Lab-Tek II chamber.
Incubate for 2-3 h at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Aspirate the medium from cells.
Rinse once with phosphate-buffered saline (PBS).
Fix for 15 min at RT with 4% paraformaldehyde (PFA) dissolved in 0.1 M phosphate buffer (PB).
Wash the cells 3x5 min with PBS.
Keep at 4°C until imaging or immunocytochemistry labeling.
Alternatively, if cell-impermeable tetrazine-dyes are to be used for labeling:
Fix the cells after labeling and washing with 4% PFA diluted in PB for 15 min at RT.
Rinse the cells 3x with PBS.
Permeabilize with 0.1% Triton X-100 diluted in PBS for 10 min at RT.
Incubate for 10 min at 37°C with the cell-impermeable tetrazine-dye diluted to a final concentration of 0.5-2.5 µM in PBS.
Pre-coat eight-well Lab-Tek II chambered coverglasses with 20 µg/ml poly-d-lysine in ddH2O for 2 h at room temperature.
Wash the chambered coverglasses three times with ddH2O and allow to dry under a sterile hood.
Incubate coated coverglasses for at least 30 min at 37°C with neuron culturing medium consisting of Neurobasal Plus (NB Plus) medium with 2% B27 Plus and 1% PS.
Thaw primary mouse cortical neurons from C57BL/6 embryonic day 17 according to the manufacturer’s recommendation.
Seed neurons at a density of 90,000-110,000 cells in 500 µl of medium per well.
Aspirate 200 µl of the medium from each well.
Add 250 µl of fresh warm NB Plus + medium.
Collect aspirated medium in tubes and keep at 4°C for further use as conditioned medium (CM).
Transfect MCNs using Lipofectamine 2000 with a DNA/Lipofectamine ratio of 1 µg:2.4 µl.
Prepare transfection medium A by adding 1% PS to Neurobasal Plus medium.
Prepare transfection medium B by adding 1% PS and 4% B27 Plus to Neurobasal Plus medium.
Warm up both transfection media to 37°C.
Add 50 µl of transfection medium A to Tube 1 for one well of an eight-well Lab-Tek II chamber.
Add 0.5 µg NFL<sup>K363TAG</sup>-FLAG, 0.5 µg NES PylRS/tRNA<sub>CUA</sub><sup>Pyl</sup>, and 0.25 µg NFM plasmid DNA to Tube 1.
Add 50 µl of transfection medium A to Tube 2 for one well of an eight-well Lab-Tek II chamber.
Add 3 µl Lipofectamine 2000 transfection reagent to Tube 2.
Vortex the tubes gently for 10 seconds.
Centrifuge briefly to spin down.
Incubate both tubes for 5 min at room temperature.
Add the contents of tube 1 to the tube 2.
Vortex the tube gently for 10 seconds, then centrifuge briefly to spin down.
Incubate the mixture for 20 minutes at room temperature.
Add 100 µl of warm transfection medium B to the transfection mix.
Mix by pipetting and avoid making bubbles.
Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Take the neurons from the incubator and aspirate all culturing medium from wells.
Add 200 µl of warm transfection mix dropwise to a maximum of 4 wells of an eight-well Lab-Tek II chambered coverglass.
Incubate for 4-6 hours at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Prepare a 1:4 dilution of TCO*A-Lys in 1 M HEPES for one well of an eight-well Lab-Tek II chamber by mixing 3.75 µl of 1 M HEPES and 1.25 µl of 100 mM TCO*A-Lys stock solution.
Add 5 µl of the HEPES-diluted TCO*A-Lys to 500 µl of warm CM aspirated from neurons before transfection for one well of an eight-well Lab-Tek II chamber.
Pre-warm the fresh NB Plus + medium and CM to 37°C.
Aspirate TCO*A-Lys from neurons and rinse twice with warm fresh NB Plus +.
Add 125 μl of CM and 125 μl of warm fresh NB Plus + per well of an eight-well Lab-Tek II chamber.
Incubate for 2-3 hours at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Prepare a 5 µM tetrazine-dye dilution in warm fresh NB Plus +.
Aspirate the medium from neurons and rinse once with warm fresh NB Plus +.
Add the tetrazine-dye dilution to the neurons.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Aspirate the tetrazine-dye dilution from neurons and rinse twice with warm fresh NB Plus +.
Add 125 μl of CM and 125 μl of warm fresh NB Plus + per well of an eight-well Lab-Tek II chamber.
Incubate the solution for a minimum of 2 hours at 37°C in 5% CO₂.
Aspirate the medium from neurons.
Fix neurons for 15 minutes at room temperature with 4% electron microscopy grade PFA diluted in PEM buffer.
Wash neurons three times for 5 minutes each with PBS.
Keep fixed neurons at 4°C until imaging or immunocytochemistry labeling.
Alternatively, replace the NB Plus + medium with Hibernate E containing 2% B27 Plus and 1% PS.
Image live cells at 37°C for up to 5 hours.

Two days after transfection (steps 4-16), label the first population of NFL using a cell-permeable tetrazine-dye in live neurons, following single-color live click chemistry labeling protocol (steps 17-23).
After labeling, incubate neurons in a 1:1 mixture of culture medium and fresh NB Plus + for 2 to 3 hours at 37°C in 5% CO₂.
Aspirate the medium from neurons.
Rinse neurons once with warm fresh NB Plus +.
Add a 1:1 mixture of CM and fresh NB Plus + containing 250 µM TCO*A-Lys.
Incubate for an additional 2 days at 37°C in 5% CO₂.
Label the second population of NFL in live neurons by following the protocol for single-color live click chemistry labeling (section II, steps 17-23).
Incubate for 2-3 hours at 37°C, 5% CO₂.
Fix the cells or proceed to live-cell imaging as described above (section II, step 26).
Alternatively, fix the cells with 4% PFA diluted in PEM buffer for 15 minutes at room temperature.
Rinse three times with PBS.
Permeabilize the cells with 0.1% Triton X-100 diluted in PBS for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Incubate for 10 minutes at 37°C with cell-impermeable tetrazine-dye diluted to a final concentration of 0.5-2.5 μM in PBS.
Aspirate the dye.
Rinse three times with PBS.
Incubate with PBS on a shaker at room temperature for 20-30 minutes.
Keep at 4°C until immunocytochemistry staining or microscopy.
